historicalIdentity.title: 放弃天空的鸟——帝企鹅 · 补片验收
historicalIdentity.script:
并非所有鸟类，都属于天空。

在地球的最南端，一群鸟类放弃了飞行，却征服了另一片广阔的世界。

它们，就是帝企鹅。

南极的冬季，气温可能降至零下四十摄氏度，狂风不断席卷冰原。

就在这样的环境中，帝企鹅开始繁衍后代。

母企鹅产下蛋后，便前往海洋寻找食物。

而企鹅爸爸，则承担起孵化的责任。

它们将蛋放在双脚上，用腹部的育儿袋保护着这个脆弱的新生命。

在漫长的孵化过程中，雄企鹅可能数月无法进食。

它们彼此依偎，轮流站在寒风中，用群体的温暖抵御严寒。

终于，当第一声稚嫩的鸣叫从蛋壳中传来，一切等待都有了意义。

它们虽然无法飞翔，却在冰冷的世界里，创造了生命最温暖的奇迹。

rightsEvidence.suggestedAttribution: Zina Deretsky / National Science Foundation, Lifecycle of the Emperor Penguin (2006), reproduced as Fig. 1 in Jenouvrier et al. (2023), doi:10.3389/frym.2023.1052262. Article: CC BY 4.0. State any permitted presentation changes.

rightsEvidence.observed: Current NSF visual-media policy distinguishes public-domain assets, contractor work, and third-party assets and says use permission is determined case by case. The fact that an image is on a government website alone is not clearance.

rightsConclusion: Specific Commons public-domain declaration and Frontiers article CC BY evidence are recorded; original USAP item permission was not independently retrieved. No new permission or final legal clearance is asserted.

manualSourceInspection.observed: Published lifecycle illustration with three incubating adults at lower left, foot-level pale eggs highlighted by original red dashed circles, and an enlarged egg linked by existing red arrows. Adjacent hatchling drawings are distinct stages.
limitations: Static egg position does not demonstrate temporal placement or transfer.
Feet and eggs are a small portion of the complete graphic.
The enlarged egg is an existing callout, not an egg lying separately on the ice.
